invoiceReminders.enabled: Automatically remind clients about overdue invoices
invoiceReminders.enabledHint: Clients without an e-mail, anonymized or blacklisted are never reminded: you are notified instead.

invoiceReminders.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change reminder settings.

import.title: Import / Export CSV
import.restricted: Import is reserved to administrators: budget expenses from the Pro plan, maintenance history on the Enterprise plan. The exports above stay available on your plan.

typeRestricted.maintenance: Maintenance history import is reserved to the Enterprise plan.
typeRestricted.expenses: Expense import is reserved to the Pro and Enterprise plans.

import.fileHint: CSV: UTF-8 or UTF-8 BOM, `;` separator. Excel: .xlsx, first sheet, headers on row 1. Max size: {size} MB, {rows} rows.

import.previewDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# duplicate skipped} other {# duplicates skipped}}

help.title: How it works
help.step1: Select a boat and the data type (maintenance or expenses).
help.step2: Upload your CSV file (UTF-8, ; separator) or Excel workbook (.xlsx, first sheet) — max {size} MB and {rows} rows.
help.step3: Review the preview: valid rows are highlighted, errors are flagged column by column, and rows already present are skipped.
help.step4: Confirm to persist the valid rows to the database.
help.formatDesc: Separator: ; (semicolon). Encoding: UTF-8 or UTF-8 BOM.
help.exportDesc: Select a boat and click the desired export link. The file is Excel-compatible (UTF-8 BOM encoding, ; separator).

expenses.formatDesc: Same file rules as maintenance. Column headers are matched loosely: French or English, upper or lower case, with or without accents.
expenses.dateFormats: Dates: {formats}, or a real date cell in Excel.
expenses.amountFormats: Amounts: decimal comma or point, thousands separators and € sign tolerated; a negative amount records a refund.
expenses.categories: Categories: {values} — French labels (carburant, entretien, escale…) are accepted; empty means "other".
expenses.duplicates: A row with the same date, label and amount as an existing expense on this boat is flagged "already present" and not imported again.
